e-commerce.title: E-commerce
e-commerce.description: A e-commerce built with React, Redux for state management, and Styled Components. This project features a dynamic carousel, real-time filtering based on categories, price, and search term, as well as responsive design. It also integrates with an API to fetch product categories and pagination.

contactList.title: Contact List
contactList.description: A contact management web application built with React, Redux for state management, and Styled Components for custom UI design. This project showcases advanced form handling and real-time updates, enhancing user experience.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A personal portfolio website created with React and Styled Components, featuring dynamic theming and internationalization (i18n). This project demonstrates ability to build responsive, multi-language applications with a focus on UI/UX design.

renovationLandingPage.title: Landing Page
renovationLandingPage.description: A professional landing page, developed using HTML, CSS, and Gulp for task automation. The project emphasizes clean, modern design and mobile responsiveness.

toDoList.title: To Do List
toDoList.description: A task management application developed using Vue.js and Bootstrap, designed for academic purposes. This project features dynamic task creation, editing, and deletion, along with a clean, responsive, and user-friendly interface. It demonstrates modern practices and component-based architecture.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: A task tracking application developed with React, Redux for efficient state management, and Styled Components for a custom UI. The app allows users to add, edit, and delete tasks, featuring local storage persistence for user convenience.

yogaLandingPage.title: Landing Page Studio
yogaLandingPage.description: A yoga studio landing page built with Bootstrap for responsive design and jQuery for form validation. This project highlights ability to create visually appealing and functional landing pages.
